# fails a command with no row and a row with no command, and
#   heading    the nearest heading above the command
#   turn       1, or 2 for the second command with this text under this heading
#   command    one line of the block (a construct over several lines is one
#              command: a newline is written \n, a backslash \\)
#              stage NAME        a stage of server/docker/ci/guide-commands.sh,
#                                which takes the command from the guide and runs
#                                it as written; a workflow step runs the stage
#              workflow FILE     a live `run:` step of .github/workflows/FILE
#                                holds the command as one of its lines
#              reason TEXT       why no check can run it
